verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a bulk-operations capability, such as bulk-editing, bulk-deleting or batch-updating many flags, insights, persons or other items in one action. The closest items do not qualify. Batch exports (scheduled data export), the generic claim that SQL can 'manage, query, and modify data', and cohort-based flag rollouts are adjacent features, not bulk operations. The 953 MCP tools and the CLI are building blocks an agent could loop over, not a bulk-operation feature.
